nom: RMS Beauty Coconut Clean Cleansing Balm

segments.oily: Several reviewers with normally oily-leaning skin report the balm rinses clean without leaving a greasy or oily film.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing decades of chronic dryness or scaling, report the balm leaves skin soft and hydrated rather than tight or stripped.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers identifying as sensitive or reactive, including one with rosacea and one with coconut sensitivity, mostly report no irritation, though one notes eye-area burning and another mentions oil-gland irritation around the eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s and 70s report the balm relieves dryness and scaling and leaves mature skin looking softer and less dull.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry, acne-prone and sensitive skin reports the balm cleans without disturbing the skin barrier.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the balm cleanses without leaving skin dry, tight or stripped, including those in dry climates; a minority disagree, with one saying it leaves skin dry and another reporting her skin feels dry afterward despite liking the product overall.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers with rosacea report visible improvement in redness with regular nightly use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the balm as non-stripping and supportive of the skin barrier, with one explicitly noting it does not leave the barrier feeling depleted.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports no breakouts from the formula, in contrast to other cleansers that broke her out.

extraits.texte: I was very excited to give this cleansing balm a try since I currently use the Elemis balm. The way this was packaged left a lot to be desired as it completely melted. . . I understand it's coconut oil. . . and leaked all over the paper bag my products were delivered in. It was even leaking through the mailer. Second, I found this balm very difficult to rinse off my face. Third, I found the texture a little strange when trying to get it out of the pot since I'm used to a cleansing balm being a little softer. I will absolutely continue to use it but, honestly, I melted this and my Elemis back down to oil and combined them.

I am completely honest, was petrified to try this makeup removal cream. I have the most sensitive and reactive skin. Have spent a fortune on skin care that promises, but just another product I wasted my money on. This works, everything it says it does it doe! Absolutely no skin reaction, cleanses thoroughly, improves skin texture. I am shocked, something that is real. Thank you, a million times over.
This worked great with my sensitive rosacea skin. Took off my mascara nicely also!

extraits.titre: Great product; careful not to drop the jar!
extraits.texte: I've been using this since shortly after it came out and love it. It's removes the makeup and leaves my skin feeling really nice, and then I use the cleansing gel after as instructed. I do not use the cleansing balm to love my eye makeup as it burned my eyes awfully. Tonight I dropped my cleansing balm and the glass shattered in a hundred pieces. Obviously one of the selling points of RMS products is that they packaged in glass, so user be careful. It took about 30 minutes to find all the shards and big and small pieces and clean them off the floor. My jar was about 75% full and unfortunately it's ruined. The remaining jar was crumbling and falling apart, and a good possibility of glass being in the cleansing balm. Money and product lost, sadly.

I love this product!! I believe it's my 3rd order. I have a terrible complexion. And my skin on my face has always been excessively dry with several patches of chronic scales. I am 73 years old and this is the first time in my adult life that I have found a product that actually moisturized the spots and stopped this chronic cycle. I can't say enough about it. Also love how soft and clear my skin looks overall. Thank you rms!! 💕

I originally tried this out in a search for a very mild eye makeup remover. Surprisingly, this has helped so much with my rosacea! I use it every night, and my skin is basically back to normal—which is amazing. I'm not sure if this is attributable to the product, but the oil glands in my eyes did get irritated after use, which could just be me not washing it off thoroughly.

Such a wonderful, creamy cleanser that leaves my skin feeling so fresh and clean, but NOT leaving my skin barrier feeling depleted or dry. I love it and am currently waiting for my second order to arrive! So glad it finally came back in stock! FYI,I have dry, but acne-prone and sensitive skin and this has been a miracle.
